verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-one blocker is resolved. The implementation now documents the relevant `git read-tree` mode distinction and, more importantly, exercises `_worktree_seal_digest` through direct and end-to-end self-test rows: it must produce a 64-hex digest from an ordinary repository, preserve HEAD/index/worktree state, remain stable for identical content, change for tracked edits and deletions, ignore gitignored build output, and fail closed for an unreadable tree. The pre-gate digest is emitted by both sealing paths, wired by exact step-output names into each live gate, validated before target-controlled code runs, and rechecked after every gate profile. The worker bundle additionally proves that the recomputed snapshot digest equals the exact patch bytes later applied by the publisher. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, test-vacuity, or security issue in the diff.
